name: Noir-inspired rotation-aligned SHA512 slices, adapted for R1CS

experiments.variant: rotation-aligned original Noir widths with independent input byte range checks
experiments.disposition: Input byte range table causes standalone regression.

experiments.variant: input bytes bound by existing 8-bit spread table
experiments.disposition: Improves both full verifier and standalone hash.
Removes 512-row table; extra Boolean constraints cost less.

validation.full_module: go test ./... -count=1 passed for every package; full-tests.log
validation.hash_cases: 0,3,32,64,96,111,112,128,257 bytes checked against crypto/sha512; wrong digest and byte256 rejected; constant IV/round constants independently derived from prime roots
validation.forged_hints: Old parity-chunk override and new typed-slice override rejected
validation.typed_slice_attacks: Width1 and width8 overflow preserve integer recomposition; top-slice overflow preserves modular carry equation. All rejected.
validation.ed25519: All 914 dalek CCTV vectors, scalar boundaries, mixed torsion/challenge and zero-S tests, host differential tests, and adversarial circuits passed in full module run.

soundness: Each original input byte is bound by a 256-row spread lookup before word packing.
Every slice has exact width membership in its own table; one-bit slices satisfy Boolean constraints.
Families sum to 64 bits and contain all their rotation/shift cuts. Dense/spread recompositions are below 2^64/2^128, parity recomposition below 2^130.
Each modular sum uses a 64-bit output and carry in [0,16), with all terms below 2^68. Native field is at least 200 bits.
State words keep A/E rotation families between blocks; only the final digest uses byte slices. Endianness, padding and hash transcript are unchanged.
cpu_work: stopped; final real proof benchmarks delegated to parent after main integration
promotion: Applied production/test patches after static review; production source matches isolated candidate byte for byte. Main verification/proof results recorded in verification-results.json.
